lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Walking through the hallway of my mind
Tracing every shadow that I left behind
The coffee's cold and the morning is grey
Waiting for the heavy clouds to sway
[Pre-Chorus]
I reached for a spark in the cold
Watching the story of my spirit unfold
[Chorus]
Now the horizon is wide and gold
Breaking every chain that I used to hold
Like a sudden warmth in the winter air
Finding my home in the light everywhere
[Verse]
The city hums a song I finally know
Planting seeds where the wild flowers grow
No more hiding in the hollow spaces
Finding my rhythm in all the familiar places
[Pre-Chorus]
I reached for a spark in the cold
Watching the story of my spirit unfold
[Chorus]
Now the horizon is wide and gold
Breaking every chain that I used to hold
Like a sudden warmth in the winter air
Finding my home in the light everywhere
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
The noise of the world begins to fade
Into the beauty of the progress I made
[Chorus]
Now the horizon is wide and gold
Breaking every chain that I used to hold
Like a sudden warmth in the winter air
Finding my home in the light everywhere
[Outro]
